scenes.prompt: Evolution Wars pixel-art broadcast animation sheet. Reference 1 is the APPROVED redesign of Gerard: weathered mischievous 48-year-old, receding unruly dark brown hair with gray temples, angular lived-in face, crooked grin, warm neutral brown/gray beard, NO BLUE in facial hair or off-white eye sclera. Blue headphones/mic, open sky-blue Hawaiian shirt with large yellow lemons and red flowers over charcoal tee. Give him angular adult hands, defined knuckles, angular fingers and subtle dark hairs on fingers and forearms, not round tiny mittens. Reference 2 is Mr Le Chevalier: older silver swept hair, rectangular dark glasses, neat small gray mustache, blue blazer, pale shirt, navy tie, headphones/mic. Preserve identities and exactly the same outfits. Gerard sits on LEFT, Le Chevalier on RIGHT. Real crisp medium-resolution pixel art with consistent clusters and palette. No gradients, no glow, no blur. Fixed front-facing broadcast camera. The duo share a single horizontal dark-blue desk with straight top. Background is solid flat very dark navy #081522. All poses must match camera, desk height, character placement and size exactly. Never zoom or reframe. This is animation, NOT a comic: NO text, NO labels, NO gutters, NO panel borders. Layout: EXACTLY SIX equal panoramic frames stacked vertically in ONE COLUMN and SIX ROWS, 1024 pixels wide by 2048 pixels high in total, each frame 1024x341 approximately, with same 3:1 wide view. Each row is one complete scene with BOTH people, their shared table and the fixed top cropping boundary. Animation A, Gerard stands up too enthusiastically and Le Chevalier tracks him with his eyes. Row1: both seated neutral forearms resting, Gerard has wry smile, Le Chevalier looking toward the arena/front. Row2: Gerard leans forward pushing his angular hands against desk preparing to stand, Le Chevalier turns head LEFT toward Gerard at eye level. Row3: Gerard is halfway standing, shoulders and torso higher, both elbows starting to lift, upper forehead begins to leave TOP of that row; Le Chevalier remains seated same exact size/position and tilts chin UP and LEFT with pupils following Gerard's ascending face. Row4: Gerard is fully STANDING with arms raised overhead, his entire HEAD and NECK and hands are OUTSIDE THE TOP OF THE FRAME, only Hawaiian-shirt TORSO and parts of raised upper arms remain visible on left above desk; do not shrink him to fit! Le Chevalier stays seated and looks clearly UP-LEFT toward the offscreen face, head tilted back, amused skeptical expression. Row5: Gerard begins sitting down, face re-enters from top, arms lower, Le Chevalier's gaze follows downward LEFT. Row6: both seated again, Gerard satisfied crooked grin, Le Chevalier glances sideways at him with raised eyebrow. Critical: top-frame clipping of standing Gerard is deliberate comedy; KEEP table and camera absolutely stationary. Maintain plausible continuous rising torso positions, never make a duplicate Gerard or change his outfit.
